notes: Level-1 NMOS low-side switch (the fan trial's device: VTO 2 V, KP 20 uA/V^2, W/L 1e4, so beta = 0.2 A/V^2). Hand-derived before the first run: gate 0 V -> OFF, no subthreshold conduction in this model, drain at 12 V; gate 10 V -> triode, R_on ~ 1/(beta*(Vgs - VTO)) = 0.625 ohm, drain ~ 12*0.625/24.625 = 0.30 V, load current ~ 0.49 A. KCL at the device: load + gate currents = source current (the gate carries only its capacitances' charging current).
